opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits payment into a cryptocurrency package and ties access to wiring funds to the company: “the only way for you to get this account is to wire functions to the company.” It then instructs viewers to submit tokens into mining—“We're Gonna Submit the tokens to mining”—while presenting the resulting calculations as returns. The speaker prominently states, “That's 245% return,” and the accompanying description advertises “a 246% ROI” while directing viewers to set up an account. These are not neutral explanations of cryptocurrency; they combine a paid package, transferred funds, token submission to a mining process, projected returns of approximately 245% to 246%, and an explicit signup path. Together, those features establish an active paid-mining return solicitation, while the stated figures remain projections rather than proof of realized earnings.
